ai_conn_delete_confirm: Delete this assistant connection? This cannot be undone.
ai_conn_delete_network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
ai_conn_empty_body: Click Quick connect to add your AI provider and API key for in-admin chat.
ai_conn_err_already_exists: You already have a connection for this provider. Edit the existing connection or delete it first.
ai_conn_err_api_key_portal: API key is required. Get one from your provider's developer portal (not from a consumer subscription).
ai_conn_err_api_key_required_detail: API key is required. Consumer subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro) do not include API access — get a key from your provider's developer console.
ai_conn_err_api_url_required: API URL is required for custom providers.
ai_conn_err_credits: API key looks valid, but the provider account may need credits before chat works.
ai_conn_err_enter_api_key_test: Enter an API key before testing.
ai_conn_err_invalid_api_key: Invalid API key. Make sure you copied the key from your provider's developer console — ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro subscriptions do not include API access.
ai_conn_err_model_not_found: Provider rejected the request — the model may be retired. Try another model (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash for Gemini). Details: {details}
ai_conn_err_ollama_reach: Cannot reach Ollama. Ensure it is running and the URL is correct from the Birkly server (not just your browser).
ai_conn_err_rate_limit: Rate limited by the provider. Wait a moment and try again, or check your API plan limits.
ai_conn_err_test_before_continue: Please test the connection before continuing, or fix any errors shown.
ai_conn_err_test_before_save: Please test the connection before saving.
ai_conn_err_test_ollama: Please test that Birkly can reach your Ollama server before continuing.
ai_conn_err_unsupported_provider: This provider is not supported for outbound connections.
ai_conn_invalid_server_response: Server returned an invalid response. Check that you are logged in and try again.
ai_conn_models_custom_hint: Enter the model ID required by your endpoint.
ai_conn_models_enter_api_key: Enter your API key to load models from {provider}.
ai_conn_models_load_hint: Load models after selecting a provider.
ai_conn_models_test_to_load: Enter your API key, then test the connection to load models.
ai_conn_save_network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your network connection and try again.
ai_conn_test_network_error: Network error — could not reach Birkly server.
delivery_confirm_fix_project_paths: Rewrite /project/ paths in project HTML and inject the client script?
delivery_confirm_repair: Repair delivery: fix CMS/public URLs if needed, sync domain aliases, remove legacy demo-website/ and default demo HTML from project/, disable harmful /project redirects, fix project HTML paths, and clear SSR cache? A backup of hosting.json will be created when config changes.
delivery_confirm_set_same_host_public: Set “Root / opens public site” on this domain? The site home page will be served at / with clean URLs and project HTML paths will be updated.
dev_debug_help: Debug helpers: add ?__dbg=1 to a public page for client logs. MCP endpoint: /mcp. Template export never includes users or secrets.
mcp_empty_service_admin_body: Click Add agent to create a shared connection with a fixed role.
mcp_empty_service_user_body: Ask an admin to assign you a service agent, or use the personal connector.
mcp_empty_service_user_title: No service agents assigned to you
mcp_http_url_warning: This URL uses HTTP. Claude will reject it — open Birkly with https:// and copy the URL again.
mcp_personal_default_desc: Connect Claude or ChatGPT with your own Birkly permissions. Every team member uses this same URL but signs in with their own account.
mcp_personal_disabled_note: Personal connector is disabled. Only admins can re-enable it.
mcp_personal_unavailable_body: Refresh the page. If this persists, contact your administrator.
mcp_preset_content_desc: Draft and edit CMS collections and entries
mcp_preset_site_builder_desc: Build and edit project/ HTML, CSS, and JS with CMS content tools
mcp_revoke_confirm: Remove this service agent? Your AI app will no longer access your site through it.
mcp_setup_personal_note: Sign in with your Birkly account — permissions follow your role.
mcp_setup_service_note: This service agent uses a fixed role set by your admin.
mcp_setup_step_copy: Copy the Connector URL below and add it as a remote MCP server in your AI app — leave Client ID/Secret empty (OAuth is automatic).
mcp_toast_copied_https: Copied. Claude requires HTTPS for remote connectors.
mcp_toast_copy_manual: Could not copy — please select the text manually.
mcp_toast_invalid_response: Server returned an invalid response. Try again.
mcp_toast_service_created: Service agent created! Copy the Connector URL into your AI app.
mcp_toast_something_wrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
mcp_write_approvals_note: Write approvals: MCP write confirmations happen in your AI app (Cursor, Claude) — not in the Birkly Approvals tab. The built-in assistant uses a separate approval flow under Settings → Built-in assistant.
project_delete_all_confirm: Delete the entire project folder? All HTML, CSS, JS, and assets will be removed. This cannot be undone.
project_delete_all_phrase_prompt: Type DELETE to confirm permanent removal of all project files.
project_delete_cancelled: Deletion cancelled — confirmation phrase did not match.
project_new_folder_invalid: Enter a single folder name without slashes.
project_ssr_engine_missing: Server rendering cannot run: the built-in PHP template engine is missing from this install. Pages will fall back to client-side rendering.
project_ssr_not_ready: Server rendering runtime is not ready. Pages will fall back to client-side rendering.
project_ssr_not_ready_reason: Server rendering is not ready on this host ({reason}). Pages will fall back to client-side rendering.
project_visit_url_save_failed: Failed to save visit URL setting
